chequeos.detalle: a real Android 15 instance's /data (19.2 GB) copied from jg-dashboard (its custom image had GApps, ndk_translation, Magisk and the fake WiFi built in) into a new instance with this combination on redroid-forge-prod: all 30 user apps present, same Google account, same GMS/GSF Android ID (4361639805900567970), the same per-app Settings.Secure ANDROID_ID values
Play Store opens signed in and loads its content; GMS 26.45.31
an ARM-only Unity game (Hero Wars, com.nexters.herowars) launches and loads with its player id, i.e. the account's progress
after one restart of the instance: connected to 'jg-wifi', default network active, DNS resolves (see problemasConocidos for the first boot)
hardware H.264 through the shared VA-API daemon (redroid-hwenc v0.3.0) with this instance's stream_id

validaciones.notas: Validated by migrating a real instance rather than with a dedicated test campaign. The user then keeps it in a 48 h trial for the Google side (identity/certification of the migrated device), which is about the migration, not about this module combination.

problemasConocidos.detalle: the fake WiFi does not connect on the instance's very first boot after creation (the interface swap happens but the connection stays DISCONNECTED, no default network, DNS fails). Restarting the instance once fixes it for good. Same behaviour as the jg-dashboard fake WiFi this module was ported from.
